boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain The University of the South
boards.description: Documented evening food and coffee stops in Sewanee and nearby Monteagle, with current posted closing times.

cards.title: Cup & Gown Cafe
cards.subtitle: duPont Library, Sewanee
cards.notes: Head to duPont Library on an eligible academic-year evening and confirm the day’s schedule before walking over for cafe service.
cards.short_summary: A library-based cafe with posted service to 11 p.m. on several days.
cards.evidence_claim: The university lists Cup & Gown Cafe in duPont Library as open Sunday–Friday until 11 p.m., with Saturday closed.
cards.source_title: Local Shops & Eateries | The University of the South
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Sun–Fri until 11 p.m.; closed Saturday. Hours are subject to change.

cards.title: Stirling's Coffee House
cards.subtitle: University Avenue, Sewanee
cards.notes: Use the posted late closing windows for a coffeehouse stop, and check the university listing before setting out on a weekend evening.
cards.short_summary: Campus coffeehouse with several posted late-evening windows.
cards.evidence_claim: The university lists Stirling's open until 10 p.m. Thursday–Saturday and until midnight on Sunday.
cards.source_title: Local Shops & Eateries | The University of the South
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Thu–Fri 7:30 a.m.–10 p.m., Sat 9 a.m.–10 p.m., Sun 9 a.m.–midnight.

cards.title: Shenanigans
cards.subtitle: 12595 Sollace M. Freeman Highway, Sewanee
cards.notes: Plan around the split daily service and verify the ordering page before leaving; its posted evening window runs through 9 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A Sewanee restaurant with a daily posted evening service period.
cards.evidence_claim: Shenanigans’ official ordering page lists daily evening service from 4:30 p.m. to 9 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Posted evening hours: 4:30–9 p.m. daily; verify availability before travel.

cards.title: Shakerag at The Sewanee Inn
cards.subtitle: 1235 University Avenue, Sewanee
cards.notes: Check the day before you go; dinner is listed later on Friday and Saturday, when the restaurant posts a 10 p.m. close.
cards.short_summary: The Sewanee Inn’s restaurant has a posted 10 p.m. weekend dinner close.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sewanee Inn lists Shakerag open 4–10 p.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Restaurants in Sewanee, TN | The Sewanee Inn
cards.access_notes: Posted dinner hours: Sun–Thu 4–9 p.m.; Fri–Sat 4–10 p.m.

cards.title: Waffle House #916
cards.subtitle: 705 W Main Street, Monteagle
cards.notes: This is the clearest all-hours option nearby: use the official location page to confirm operations before making the Monteagle trip.
cards.short_summary: An official 24-hour restaurant listing in nearby Monteagle.
cards.evidence_claim: Waffle House’s official location page lists the Monteagle restaurant as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Taco Bell Monteagle
cards.subtitle: 360 Dixie Lee Avenue, Monteagle
cards.notes: For the latest listed drive-through window, confirm the location page and plan transport before traveling from the Mountain.
cards.short_summary: A nearby drive-through with a posted 2 a.m. close.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official Monteagle page lists drive-through hours of 9 a.m.–2 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Official posted drive-through hours: 9 a.m.–2 a.m. daily; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Wendy's Monteagle
cards.subtitle: 640 Dixie Lee Avenue, Monteagle
cards.notes: Use the official location page for a time-sensitive stop; both restaurant and drive-through are listed as open around the clock.
cards.short_summary: A nearby Wendy’s with official 24-hour restaurant and drive-through hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official Monteagle page lists both restaurant and drive-through hours as open 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Official posted restaurant and drive-through hours: open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: McDonald's Monteagle
cards.subtitle: 521 W Main Street, Monteagle
cards.notes: Confirm whether you need the lobby or drive-through: the official location lists different weekend closing times for each service.
cards.short_summary: A Monteagle location with Friday and Saturday drive-through service to midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s official Monteagle page lists Friday and Saturday drive-through hours until 12 a.m.; lobby hours run until 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official posted drive-through hours: until midnight Fri–Sat; restaurant/lobby until 11 p.m. daily.

cards.title: Pizza Hut Monteagle
cards.subtitle: 918 W Main Street, Monteagle
cards.notes: For a later carryout plan, use the official location page and check whether Friday or Saturday’s 11 p.m. closing applies.
cards.short_summary: Pizza carryout with posted 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut’s official location page lists the Monteagle restaurant open until 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Pizza Hut Takeout, 918 W Main, Monteagle
cards.access_notes: Official posted restaurant hours: until 11 p.m. Fri–Sat; until 10 p.m. other days.

cards.title: Subway Monteagle
cards.subtitle: 727 W Main Street, Monteagle
cards.notes: Keep this as an earlier-evening Monteagle option and verify the store page before departing, particularly when schedules change seasonally.
cards.short_summary: A nearby sandwich shop with official 9 p.m. daily posted hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Subway’s official Monteagle page lists store hours of 8 a.m.–9 p.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Official posted store hours: 8 a.m.–9 p.m. daily.
